nodes.name: Act 4 (Ngamakanui)
nodes.summary: Fourth act of Path of Exile 2 (added in 0.3.0 The Third Edict). The Exile, the Hooded One and Doryani sail from Kingsmarch around the Karui archipelago Ngamakanui to recover three Precursor weapon pieces, find a forge, and reforge the Weapon meant to destroy the Beast, clashing with the Twilight Order and the Tukohama chieftain Tavakai.

nodes.name: Act 5 (Oriath)
nodes.summary: Announced/datamined fifth act, not released as of 2026-11-05 (planned for the 1.0 release, 2026-12-11). Wiki text: set in Oriath, secretly rebuilt by the Twilight Order after Sirus destroyed it, where the player arrives in search of the Beast. Datamined listings name Slums, Grand Arena, Gardens, Den of Pleasure, Pantheon of the Forsaken Gods and bosses incl. Lumerius and the Countess; treat all details as unconfirmed.

nodes.name: Act 6 (final act)
nodes.summary: Announced sixth and final act of the PoE2 campaign, not released as of 2026-11-05. The PoE2 wiki only calls it the 'sixth and final storyline act'; no story content is confirmed. Rumours of its setting (e.g. inside the Beast) are unverified fan speculation.

nodes.name: Interlude 1: Curse of Holten (Ezomytes)
nodes.summary: First Interlude after Act 4: the Hooded One takes the Exile to Ogham where Renly's Ezomytes are being abducted by Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth of Holten. Defeating them wins the Ezomytes for the war on Oriath. GGG reportedly intends Interludes to go away when Acts 5-6 arrive (non-canon status unverified).

sources.locator: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: Interlude 2: The Stolen Barya (Maraketh)
nodes.summary: Second Interlude: in the Vastiri, Sekhema Asala needs the Maraketh unified for war; the Sel Khari guardians of the First Barya are lost to a Faridun/Serpent Clan attack led by Prince Azmadi, whom the Exile defeats so the Gifting of Water can proceed.

sources.locator: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: Interlude 3: Doryani's Contingency (Vaal)
nodes.summary: Third Interlude: Doryani's reserves, the Cuachic Vault on Mount Kriar, are woken with the code phrase 'the time of the sparrow has come'; the Exile subdues Zolin and Zelina and the Cuachic Vaal pledge to the war.

sources.locator: Act list: Interlude 1 - The Curse of Holten / 2 - The Stolen Barya / 3 - Doryani's Contingency

nodes.name: Epilogue / Endgame (Legacy of the Precursors)
nodes.summary: Endgame container (0.5.0) opened when the attempt to sail on Oriath ends at the Ziggurat Refuge: the Hooded One sleeps in corruption, Doryani builds a Waygate and the hunt for the Edicts begins. Distinct from PoE1's Epilogue.

nodes.name: Rise of the Abyssal (0.3.0)
nodes.summary: Challenge league launched 2025-08-29 with The Third Edict (v0.3.0), the release that added Act 4, the Interludes and Abyss content.

nodes.name: The Last of the Druids / Fate of the Vaal (0.4.0)
nodes.summary: 0.4.0 expansion (2025-12-12) with the Fate of the Vaal league (Atziri's Temple); background to Doryani/Vaal threads continuing into the endgame.

nodes.name: Return of the Ancients / Runes of Aldur (0.5.0)
nodes.summary: 0.5.0 expansion (2026-05-29) adding the Legacy of the Precursors endgame story (Arbiter of Ash, Origin Tower, Arbiter of Divinity) and the Runes of Aldur league (Farrow, Verisium, Kalguuran runes). Runes of Aldur is expected to end before the 1.0 release.

nodes.name: PoE2 1.0 full release
nodes.summary: Announced at Gamescom Opening Night Live (Aug 2026): Path of Exile 2 leaves Early Access on 2026-12-11 with a six-act campaign (Acts 5 and 6 new). Meta/release fact, not an in-world event.

nodes.name: Ngamakanui
nodes.summary: The Karui 'archipelago': per Kahuturoa, not a fixed place but wherever the Karui bring their Way ('Makanui is our Way'); the Karui deliberately keep its location from the Vaal. Act 4 is set among its islands around Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: [5:33] Kahuturoa: 'Ngamakanui isn't a place, not really.'

nodes.name: Kingsmarch
nodes.summary: Kalguuran harbour town on Ngamakanui, hub of Act 4 where the Exile hires the Aurora May. Founded in PoE1's Settlers of Kalguur; Tujen says they first picked the spot to stash supplies and 'now it's going to be a city'. In the epilogue its ruins are revisited by Dannig and Makoru.

nodes.name: Ngakanu
nodes.summary: Tukohama-tribe settlement under Chieftain Tavakai, reached late in Act 4; a hostile Blood Fever zone after Tavakai's declaration. Kaimana lives here.

nodes.name: Heart of the Tribe
nodes.summary: Ngakanu's sacred core with the Meeting House (Words of Akoya) and the Act 4 final boss arena where Tavakai is fought.

sources.locator: map: Heart of the Tribe, Act Boss Tavakai

nodes.name: Isle of Kin
nodes.summary: Act 4 island with the Volcanic Warrens; boss The Blind Beast and Krutog, Lord of Kin. Doomed Mine holds Niko's Feverish Writings.

nodes.name: Whakapanu Island
nodes.summary: Lush Act 4 island whose Karui carvings tell of settlers repeatedly vanishing into the Singing Caverns, where the Siren Diamora hunts; boss Great White One.

nodes.name: Shrike Island
nodes.summary: Act 4 island where Karui youths take the Test of Might; boss Scourge of the Skies.

nodes.name: Abandoned Prison / Solitary Confinement
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire prison island; staff fed prisoners their own regrowing flesh after the Cataclysm (Tattered Diary). Solitary Confinement holds The Prisoner, sealed by Emperor Chitus under an order from Izaro.

nodes.name: Kedge Bay and Journey's End
nodes.summary: Fog-covered island whose Karui totems keep Tangmazu (appearing as Freya Hartlin) imprisoned; its fog disrupts Kingsmarch trade.

nodes.name: Eye of Hinekora / Halls of the Dead
nodes.summary: Karui afterlife realm unlocked by rescuing Matiki: Tests of Mettle for Kaom, Maata and Rakiata, the Halls of the Dead with Yama's trial and the audience with Hinekora.

nodes.name: Plunder's Point
nodes.summary: Island unlocked via the Torn Map Pieces of The Runeseeker; abandoned Kalguuran post (Cadigan the Wise's notes) and an Expedition encounter.

nodes.name: Ziggurat Refuge
nodes.summary: Where the Exile unintentionally ends up instead of Oriath; Doryani's Ziggurat above Precursor leylines holds the Waygate/Map Device.

nodes.name: Oriath
nodes.summary: Former Templar capital destroyed by Sirus in PoE1; PoE2 outsiders think it was abandoned 20 years ago, but the Twilight Order secretly rebuilt its heart and keeps the Beast here (Kanu, Act 4). Setting of the unreleased Act 5.

nodes.name: Ogham
nodes.summary: Ezomyte village and Act 1 seat of Count Geonor; in Interlude 1 again besieged by the darkness from neighbouring Holten.

nodes.name: Holten
nodes.summary: Ezomyte holding of Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth, behind the Blackwood; centre of the Curse of Holten.

sources.locator: Enter Holten / Defeat the Thane and Lady

nodes.name: Qimah
nodes.summary: Maraketh city where the Gifting of Water is held; Qimah Reservoir is Azmadi's arena.

nodes.name: Mount Kriar and the Cuachic Vault
nodes.summary: Most isolated peak of the Azmeri Ranges; its summit Cuachic Vault holds Doryani's sealed Vaal reserves.

nodes.name: Slums and Grand Arena (Oriath)
nodes.summary: Named on the PoE2 wiki as the progression areas of Act 5; datamined further areas: Gardens, Den of Pleasure, Pantheon of the Forsaken Gods. Unreleased.

nodes.name: Tavakai, the Chieftain
nodes.summary: Chieftain of the Karui Tukohama Tribe and Act 4 boss. After the weapon is reforged he steals it and flees to Ngakanu with his daughter Makoru, falls to Blood Fever, claims to be the true 'Ngakuramakoi', is rejected by Tukohama, is defeated, then cured by Sin and pledges the Karui to the war against Oriana.

sources.locator: Defeat Tavakai; Witness the Hooded One

nodes.name: Alva Valai
nodes.summary: PoE1 (Incursion) explorer who travels with the Exile and the Hooded One to Kingsmarch, goes ahead to her contact Rog in Kingsmarch and then departs to study a tome. Continuity link to PoE1.

nodes.name: Rog, the Dealer
nodes.summary: Kalguuran trader, Alva's contact in Kingsmarch, who sells the Boat Charter; returning from PoE1's Settlers of Kalguur.

nodes.name: Tujen, the Harbourmaster
nodes.summary: Kalguuran haggler/harbourmaster of Kingsmarch; gives Dark Mists and recalls the town's founding.

sources.locator: Tujen: 'Kingsmarch trade has seen better days'

nodes.name: Dannig, the Blacksmith
nodes.summary: Kalguuran warrior skald and smith in Kingsmarch who forges the Verisium Spikes freeing Freya Hartlin and later runes; sings tales the Karui like.

nodes.name: Ange
nodes.summary: Kingsmarch marketeer (Hostile Takeover) who learnt from Rog and Faustus ('rest his soul' - Faustus is dead) and sets up the Shoreline Hideout.

nodes.name: Farrow, the Runeseeker
nodes.summary: Ezomyte runesmith in Kingsmarch researching rune origins and powerful Verisium; The Runeseeker quest leads to Plunder's Point; the Runes of Aldur league character.

nodes.name: Kaimana
nodes.summary: Karui healer-alchemist at Ngakanu working on a Blood Fever cure; sends the Exile for the Great White shark's fin. Says 'If the ancestors see you... you can never truly die'.

nodes.name: Matiki
nodes.summary: Karui held on one of the Act 4 islands (rotating location) whose rescue unlocks the Eye of Hinekora and Trial of the Ancestors.

nodes.name: Navali, Speaker of Hinekora
nodes.summary: Karui seer who guides the Exile through the Halls of the Dead and presents them to the Mother of Death. Also appeared in PoE1 (Prophecy, Ancestor).

nodes.name: Yama the White
nodes.summary: Boss of the Halls of the Dead, fought as Yama's Test: 'Old Yama see if worthy of Hinekora!'

nodes.name: Hinekora
nodes.summary: Karui goddess, the Mother of Death, ruler of the Halls of the Dead, seer of prophecy; speaks through the Well of Passing and rewards the worthy with the Tattoo of Hinekora.

sources.locator: Peer into the Well of Passing

nodes.name: Tukohama
nodes.summary: Karui god of war; in the Act 4 boss fight Tavakai calls on him ('Lend me your strength') and Tukohama refuses: 'This... is not the Way.'

nodes.name: Tangmazu, the Trickster God (Freya Hartlin)
nodes.summary: Trickster being imprisoned by the Ramako and later Tukohama tribes at Journey's End; disguised as Freya Hartlin, freed with Verisium Spikes, triggering a Delirium encounter. Elder Madox later calls the Raven Trickster 'he of many names and many faces' (identification only implied).

nodes.name: Captain Hartlin
nodes.summary: Freya Hartlin's son; he died and became the undead boss of Journey's End. His last words, 'Do not... believe his lies...', implicitly warn against Tangmazu (inference).

nodes.name: Krutog, Lord of Kin
nodes.summary: Kin Tyrant boss of the Volcanic Warrens on the Isle of Kin, killed in Land of the Kin.

nodes.name: Diamora, Song of Death
nodes.summary: Siren boss in the Singing Caverns of Whakapanu Island, behind the vanishing Karui settlers.

nodes.name: The Prisoner
nodes.summary: Being held 'beyond death' in Solitary Confinement by the Eternal Empire; boss and weapon-piece holder. Identity unknown.

nodes.name: Missionary Lorandis
nodes.summary: Twilight Order preacher in Kingsmarch/Arastas who lures the Exile to take an oath to the Saviour and is dismayed when Torvian ambushes them.

sources.locator: Follow the Preacher; Survive the ambush

nodes.name: Servitor Marius
nodes.summary: Twilight Order servitor on Arastas who offers the Exile membership in the Utopia or a donation; refusal completes the Utopia quest.

nodes.name: Renly
nodes.summary: Ezomyte leader in Ogham (Warrior's father figure); asks the Exile to stop Holten's abductions before the Ezomytes join the war.

nodes.name: Una
nodes.summary: Ezomyte ally who guides the Exile through the Blackwood using freed fey spirits.

nodes.name: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth
nodes.summary: Ezomyte rulers of Holten driven mad into bloodletting and torture; killed by the Exile. Cause attributed to a 'Nameless' darkness far older than Corruption (Hooded One).

sources.locator: Renly; Hooded One; Defeat the Thane and Lady

nodes.name: Sekhema Asala
nodes.summary: Maraketh Sekhema of the Ardura who unifies the akharas for war; officiates the Gifting of Water at Qimah.

nodes.name: Jado
nodes.summary: Order of the Djinn agent who infiltrated the Sel Khari to guard the First Barya; promises the Order will 'be there' in Oriath.

nodes.name: Azmadi, the Faridun Prince
nodes.summary: Self-styled Faridun prince leading a rogue sect, allied with the Serpent Clan, who attacked the Gifting of Water; defeated at Qimah Reservoir.

nodes.name: Zolin and Zelina
nodes.summary: Cuachic Vaal blood priest and priestess guarding the Cuachic Vault; recognise Doryani and pledge to march to war.

sources.locator: Defeat Zolin and Zelina; Speak to Doryani

nodes.name: Doryani
nodes.summary: Vaal Royal Thaumaturge (PoE1) companion of the PoE2 Exile: drives the Weapon search, prepares contingency Vaal reserves and in the endgame builds the Waygate.

nodes.name: The Hooded One
nodes.summary: The god Sin in disguise (identity confessed in Act 2: 'I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin'). In Act 4 he reforges the Weapon, recognises Precursor writing from a faded mortal childhood, cures Tavakai and organises the alliance; in the endgame he sleeps under the Beast's Corruption.

sources.locator: Quote 'I am the Thief of Virtue. I am Sin.'

nodes.name: Sin, the Thief of Virtue
nodes.summary: PoE1 god, twin brother of Innocence (the stained-glass version of their tale is Templar propaganda), who planted the Dark Ember/Seed beneath Highgate to grow the Beast and lull the gods; in PoE2 he is the Hooded One (revealed in Act 2).

nodes.name: Kulemak, the Lich Lord
nodes.summary: Abyssal god of undeath whose Well of Souls is in Act 2; lieutenants Amanamu, Ulaman and Kurgal; the Lurking Creature calls Sin 'Stealer of Kulemak's spark'. Relevant to endgame via Tecrod.

nodes.name: Count Geonor (Enigma Chamber)
nodes.summary: Count Geonor returns as an endgame challenge fight in the Precursor Enigma Chambers of Legacy of the Precursors.

nodes.name: Lumerius
nodes.summary: Son of the Countess; datamine lists him as an Act 5 boss in Oriath. Role unverified.

nodes.name: The Countess (Orianna) - Act 5
nodes.summary: Datamine lists 'Orianna, The Countess' among Act 5 bosses; consistent with the wiki's account that Kanu revealed the Beast is kept in Oriath. Unreleased.

nodes.name: Ursea, The Matron
nodes.summary: Named in Act 5 datamine as a boss/text-audio entry. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Phanos, Last Disciple of Auria
nodes.summary: Named in Act 5 datamine as a boss/text-audio entry. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Essie and Paulius
nodes.summary: Paired Act 5 boss in datamine. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: The High Priest
nodes.summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; identity unknown. Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: The Preacher
nodes.summary: Act 5 boss in datamine; possibly linked to the Order's preachers like Lorandis (speculation). Unreleased; no lore available.

nodes.name: Karui
nodes.summary: Island people of Ngamakanui (Tukohama, Tasalio, Ngamahu, Tawhoa, Hinekora tribes) who in Act 4 ally with the Exile; ancestors remain in the Halls of the Dead and 'Ngakuramakoi' can be non-Karui by blood.

nodes.name: Kalguuran settlers
nodes.summary: Runesmith people of Middengard who built Kingsmarch (Rog, Tujen, Dannig, Gwennen), led by the Cadigan kings; PoE1 Settlers of Kalguur continues into PoE2 Act 4.

nodes.name: Order of the Djinn
nodes.summary: Secret order (Jado's) replenishing its ranks; Jado confirms they infiltrated the Sel Khari and will be in Oriath.

nodes.name: Faridun rogue sect
nodes.summary: Faridun sect led by Prince Azmadi, allied with the Serpent Clan avenging Keth's queen.

nodes.name: Cuachic Vaal
nodes.summary: Sealed Vaal remnant under Mount Kriar loyal to Doryani; The Hooded One warns the pact lasts only while there is a common enemy.

nodes.name: Meridian Free Traders
nodes.summary: Kingsmarch guild under which Makoru's Aurora May works; requires an account and charter from Rog.

nodes.name: Feverish Writings (Niko)
nodes.summary: Letter by Niko ('Your master, Niko') in the Doomed Mine on the Isle of Kin, urging miners to gather sulphite while a blind beast whispers in the dark. Continues PoE1's Niko (Delve) into PoE2.

nodes.name: Emperor's Warning
nodes.summary: Notice at The Prisoner's arena: 'By the order of Emperor Izaro... The prisoner within is beyond death.' signed Emperor Chitus Perandus.

nodes.name: Tavakai's Declaration
nodes.summary: In-game note found in Ngakanu: Tavakai declares the 'era of the Mighty', that the last Ngakuramakoi's body will become the new world and that 'The End of Time has come'.

nodes.name: The Weapon (instrument of the Third Edict)
nodes.summary: Three Precursor weapon pieces (rotating on Act 4 islands) are reforged by the Hooded One in the Excavated Site; the inscription reads 'The instrument of the Third Edict', made for cleansing Corruption and destroying the Beast. Radiates intense Corruption and drives Tavakai mad.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon; Return to Kingsmarch

nodes.name: Seed of Corruption
nodes.summary: Precursor essence from which Sin grew the Beast; stolen by Count Geonor in Act 1 and carried off by Oriana. Doryani guesses it was the instrument of a Second Edict.

sources.locator: Doryani: 'the instrument of a Second Edict'

nodes.name: Arrival in Kingsmarch
nodes.summary: Exile, Hooded One and Doryani reach Kingsmarch to find the Weapon; Doryani laments science never recovered; the Hooded One says the Kalguurans 'have potential'.

nodes.name: Charter of the Aurora May
nodes.summary: Alva introduces Rog, who sells a Boat Charter for Vaal treasure; Makoru and Kanu will take the Exile to the most dangerous islands.

sources.locator: Talk to Alva; Take the Boat Charter

nodes.name: Island search for weapon pieces
nodes.summary: The Exile clears islands (Isle of Kin, Shrike Island, Whakapanu, Abandoned Prison, Kedge Bay) to find three weapon pieces, assigned randomly each league; bosses include Krutog, Diamora, the Prisoner, the Scourge of the Skies.

nodes.name: Utopia on Arastas
nodes.summary: Missionary Lorandis sends the Exile to Arastas to swear an oath to the Saviour; Servitor Marius offers Utopia; refusal completes the quest, and Benedictus and Kanu's treachery follow.

nodes.name: Tavakai seizes the Weapon
nodes.summary: After the reforging Tavakai takes the Weapon for the Karui and flees to Ngakanu with Makoru; the Hooded One warns of its Corruption.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon

nodes.name: Tavakai defeated at Heart of the Tribe
nodes.summary: Tavakai fights in three phases; Tukohama rejects him ('This... is not the Way'); the Exile defeats him.

nodes.name: Sin cures Tavakai and Makoru
nodes.summary: The Hooded One, called Sin in the quest log, cures Tavakai and Makoru of Blood Fever with the Weapon; Tavakai pledges the Karui to fight Oriana.

sources.locator: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru

nodes.name: Alliance plan against Oriath
nodes.summary: The Hooded One decides to call the Ezomytes, Maraketh and Vaal (Doryani's reserves) to war before assaulting Oriath; the Karui are already allied.

nodes.name: Freeing the Trickster at Journey's End
nodes.summary: Exile frees 'Freya Hartlin' with Verisium Spikes; she reveals herself as Tangmazu, triggering a Delirium encounter with Omniphobia.

nodes.name: Trial of the Ancestors
nodes.summary: Matiki's rescue leads to Tests of Mettle, Yama's trial and Hinekora, who offers 'Her power... if you will accept it.'

nodes.name: Recruit the Ezomytes (Curse of Holten)
nodes.summary: Exile kills Isolde, Heldra, Siora, then Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth, ending Holten's blight; Renly pledges all clans to the war.

nodes.name: Recruit the Maraketh (The Stolen Barya)
nodes.summary: Exile defeats Elzarah, Vornas and Prince Azmadi to save the First Barya; Asala completes the Gifting of Water and brings the Maraketh to Kingsmarch.

nodes.name: Recruit the Vaal (Doryani's Contingency)
nodes.summary: The code phrase 'the time of the sparrow has come' and defeat of Rakkar, Stormgore, Zolin and Zelina secures the Cuachic.

nodes.name: Landing at the Ziggurat Refuge
nodes.summary: Siege of Oriath ends not at Oriath but at the Ziggurat Refuge; Quest Complete text says 'despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'. Why is not stated; the Beast's corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall afterwards.

sources.locator: Doryani: Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One

nodes.name: Doryani's Waygate
nodes.summary: Doryani builds a Waygate on Precursor leylines at the Ziggurat; Waystones and the Map Device open the endgame Atlas.

nodes.name: Gods awaken after the Beast's death
nodes.summary: About 20 years before PoE2 an exile killed the Beast, waking the slumbering gods, who per the Twilight Order now make civilisation impossible.

nodes.name: Assault on Oriath (planned Act 5)
nodes.summary: Announced Act 5: arrive in Oriath hunting the Beast; datamined quests The Siege of Oriath, Infiltrating Oriath, etc.

nodes.name: Hooded One recalls Precursor script
nodes.summary: On the first and second Weapon pieces the Hooded One recognises Precursor writing from a faded mortal memory (a woman's lap, a vivid book; later: sent to live among the Azmeri with a brother and sister, but earlier 'somewhere else' with works of stone, metal and glass).

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One (1st and 2nd pieces)

nodes.name: Exile defeats Torvian
nodes.summary: On Arastas the Exile defeats Torvian, Hand of the Saviour, after the Twilight Order ambush at the church.

sources.locator: Defeat Torvian, Hand of the Saviour

nodes.name: Exile defeats Benedictus
nodes.summary: In the Excavation the Countess leaves Benedictus to hold the Exile; he is defeated, and Kanu, begging to be taken along, reveals the Beast is in Oriath before Tavakai strikes him down.

sources.locator: Confront Kanu and the First Herald; Defeat Benedictus

nodes.name: Weapon reforged; Third Edict revealed
nodes.summary: In the Excavated Site the Hooded One reforges the Weapon and Tavakai seizes it; back in Kingsmarch the Hooded One reads the inscription 'The instrument of the Third Edict', made to cleanse Corruption and destroy the Beast.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon; Return to Kingsmarch

nodes.name: Siege of Oriath quest
nodes.summary: After all three Interludes the Hooded One plans the assault on Oriath; sailing there ends instead at the Ziggurat Refuge. The wiki infobox files the quest under Act 4.

nodes.name: Legacy of the Precursors
nodes.summary: First endgame quest (0.5.0): the Hooded One lies in Corruption-induced sleep and Doryani, with the Waygate, begins the search for ancient knowledge.

nodes.name: Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia
nodes.summary: Twilight Order herald, boss of the Excavation; left by the Countess to bury the Exile.

sources.locator: Confront Kanu and the First Herald
